Class EnemySpaceship

java.lang.Object
com.r3m.spaceshooter.entity.Spaceship
com.r3m.spaceshooter.entity.EnemySpaceship
Direct Known Subclasses:
EliteEnemyShip, GruntEnemyShip
public abstract class EnemySpaceship extends Spaceship
Shared behavior for every enemy ship type: flies straight from right to left and decides each frame whether to fire at the player. Concrete subclasses (GruntEnemyShip, EliteEnemyShip) only need to define their own speed, reload time, appearance, and shooting rule via decideToShoot() — this base class handles movement, cooldown timing, and screen-edge cleanup.
